what: onsemi makes power and sensing chips: silicon carbide and silicon power devices that manage electricity in electric vehicles and industrial equipment, and image sensors used in car cameras.
customers: Carmakers and their suppliers, industrial equipment makers, and increasingly data centre power system builders.
money: silicon carbide and silicon power devices
image sensors for automotive and industrial vision
moat: Silicon carbide manufacturing from its own substrates through to finished devices, a vertically integrated position very few competitors have.
risks: Revenue fell about 15% last year and about 10% a year over three years
Electric vehicle demand growth slowed sharply in Europe and North America
Chinese silicon carbide suppliers have pushed prices down
opportunities: Analysts see about 39% upside from current levels
Cash of about $4.4 billion roughly matches its debt
Data centre power conversion is a new market for its silicon carbide devices
watch: Silicon carbide revenue and design wins, and factory utilisation.
